verdict.rationale: Adyen documents control over payout timing: payout frequency can be configured per merchant account, and merchants can choose when and in which currency to settle. The reporting evidence only promises a visual overview of balances, sales, and payouts, with nothing showing which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout. missing for 10: documented per-payout reconciliation or settlement breakdown of charges, fees, and refunds, and independent or hands-on corroboration of payout scheduling.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can control the payout schedule and see exactly which charges, fees, and refunds make up each payout

citations.quote: You can configure the payout frequency for each of your merchant accounts.
Choose when and in which currency you want to settle.
This means you have the option to change how you get paid for each of your merchant accounts.
Get a visual representation of your balances, sales, and payouts.
